summary: Both round-1 minors are fully resolved. F-02 (timeout orphan edge): useFunnelCanvas.ts line 251 now guards stepType === 'MESSAGE' before emitting a timeout edge, exactly mirroring hasTimeoutHandle in FunnelCanvasNode.vue (line 83 requires isMessageStep). Two new unit tests cover the negative case (non-MESSAGE step with timeoutTargetStepId → no edge emitted) and the positive case (MESSAGE step → edge emitted), plus the existing full-round-trip test already exercised the MESSAGE path. detectBrokenEdges still flags timeoutTargetStepId for all step types regardless of stepType, which is intentionally conservative — it surfaces data-integrity violations that buildEdges silently drops, and server validation prevents such states in practice. F-01 (dead i18n key): preview.imageUnavailable removed from en.json, uk.json, and required-keys.spec.ts; a full-codebase grep confirms zero remaining references. No regressions found.
